gaps: direct Spring stereotypes/controllers/routes/route prefixes, Java and Kotlin constructor parameter dependencies, @Bean/@ConfigurationProperties, JPA relation fields and method-security annotations are materialized as authored source evidence

meta/composed annotations, same-package/wildcard/generic target resolution, Spring Data generated repository behavior and functional WebFlux nested DSL targets require generic resolver/external semantic evidence

runtime bean conditions/profiles/autoconfiguration/proxy/container selection, SpEL evaluation and actual authorization decisions are runtime state; computed route constants require bounded value resolution
JPA fetch/cascade/mappedBy annotation options are preserved as generic annotation evidence where available; runtime ORM metadata is not executed
